name: Observe a pending native spy after production without advancing a turn

condition.code: local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; return p and p:IsTurnActive() and type(ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary)=='table'
local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; if b.lastAction=='ERROR_BIND_SPY' then error(b.lastAction) end; return Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_SPY')~=nil

steps.code: local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; local r=Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_ENEMY_SPY_RETRY'); local s=b.ReadEnemy(); assert(r.spyID and r.spyID~=r.archive.spyID and s.spy and s.spy.present and s.spy.id==r.spyID,'new native spy not bound'); return 'NEW_SPY_BOUND'
